records.headline: Frontier Press Dispatch
records.summary: A public article about a cave rescue drill and a road closure.
article: The Frontier Press reports that a stretch of the mine road was closed while volunteers staged a rescue drill near the old cave trail.
Witnesses describe lantern signals on the ridge and a temporary relay post set up to coordinate the exercise.

images.alt: Archived newspaper photo of the cave entrance.
images.caption: Printed alongside the rescue drill article.

records.headline: Prairie Telegram
records.summary: A subscriber-only freight article without photographs.
article: The Prairie Ledger covers delayed winter freight and a weather bulletin passed between relay crews after midnight.
An editorial note mentions that the archived subscriber edition includes extra logistics details omitted from the public print.

records.headline: Red River Bulletin
records.summary: A public clipping with a small accompanying photo.
article: The Northern Review prints a short bulletin on river levels and market notes for northern supply stations.
A later paragraph remarks on how recent trail repairs may change shipping times to the district outbuildings.

images.alt: Inset image archived with the bulletin.
images.caption: Inset print reproduced from the original paper archive.
